exclusions._snwprintf: not imported by UCC.exe, Core.dll, Engine.dll, GlmLib.dll or Editor.dll
exclusions.swscanf, swprintf, _snprintf, _vsnprintf: not reached by the original `ucc make` (main session's import trace); _snprintf/_vsnprintf keep their B/K/E cases (PENDING without an adapter)
exclusions.outputs of 16384 characters or more: B lines: SKIP (the measuring call has a 16384-character capacity)
exclusions.F2 (ACP 932 command-line splitting): separate test experiments/xrt/tests/f2_mbcs_argv, open, not part of this formatter result
exclusions.DBCS code pages for the path and string: T and F lines run under the system ANSI code page (recorded in fs.acp); behaviour under ACP 932 belongs to the open F2 work and is not claimed here
exclusions.TZ and __MSVCRT_HEAP_SELECT environment: removed from the environment of every process (generator, both sides, isolated runs): F-line times use the system time zone (recorded in fs, with whether DST was in effect at the run), and msvcr70 selects its heap the default way (system heap on NT 5+)
exclusions.access times in F lines: every access time in the tree is the run's start time T0: NTFS refreshes a last-access time that is more than an hour old when the file is opened, so historical access times would not stay fixed. Creation and write times are fixed historical values
exclusions.times in the tree snapshot: the snapshot compares names, attributes, sizes and contents; times are compared through _findfirst/_findnext only
exclusions._set_se_translator invocation: X lines check the recorded and returned translators only; whether a translator runs when a structured exception crosses a C++ try block belongs to exception dispatch (the runtime does not translate structured exceptions), not tested here
exclusions.qsort comparators: harness comparators (int32, wrapping difference, descending, first-byte key, constant 0); the engine's own comparators run as translated code and are not reproduced
exclusions.heap addresses: Z lines record success, content preservation and _msize, never addresses

extended_run.note: includes the narrow sprintf (A) and bounded (B, K, E) cases; the 4 mismatches are the _vsnwprintf NULL-destination cases of the default run (E lines do not depend on the seed)

narrow_sprintf.found_and_fixed: narrow-string conversions (%s, %hs) with a negative precision other than -1 (e.g. %.*5s with * = -1): msvcr70's narrow _output prints the whole string (while (i-- && *p)); xrt_output printed nothing (17 cases) until the fix in xrt_fmt.c the same day

before_fix.adapters: runtime/xrt_fmt.c and runtime/hle_msvcr70.c at commit edb955c, same corpus (seed 20261022)
before_fix.excluded: cases the original cannot survive: %Z (fatal), widths/precisions of 0x7FFFFFFF (host out of memory), float precisions 512/513/600 (stack buffer overflow in cfltcvt)
